subject.title: fix(msteams): reset sessions on app removal lifecycle

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose the scoped `resetSessionEntryLifecycle` Plugin SDK/runtime contract, including owner-coordinated locked-harness release, to support this Teams lifecycle fix?
rationale: The PR is technically focused and tested, but its central enabling mechanism expands the supported plugin session API beyond a Teams-only repair; source-level review cannot determine whether that external contract is intended long-term.

options.title: Accept the scoped lifecycle API
options.body: Approve the documented owner-scoped reset primitive and merge the Teams fix with the current ownership and rollback tests.

options.title: Keep the reset private to core
options.body: Reject the public SDK expansion and ask for a narrower Teams/core-owned implementation that does not establish a new external plugin contract.

options.title: Pause for API design
options.body: Keep the PR open while an owner defines the supported harness-reset and lifecycle-rotation contract for external plugins.

recommendation.title: Accept the scoped lifecycle API
recommendation.body: Approve the documented owner-scoped reset primitive and merge the Teams fix with the current ownership and rollback tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The visible history includes the personal-scope lifecycle refinement, making this the strongest available owner candidate for the API-boundary decision.
